lines.trans: What are you doing here?
I work here now.
What are you working as, a cleaner?
You are a manager, Marina, what will people say?
And what will people say when they find out about you at work?
Marina, I do not have any romances at work.
I am going to work here now until the end of my vacation.
Is everything clear to you?
Why did you hire her?
So people do not say that we took jobs away from the locals.
And I am also curious how this soap opera will end.
